attempted_claim: The named 4-regular acyclic Borel homomorphism graph H4 satisfies chi_B(H4)=5 while chi_mu(H4)=3 and chi_BM(H4)=3: no Borel 4-coloring exists, yet H4 admits a measure-measurable 3-coloring and a Baire-measurable 3-coloring.
claim_type: exact vertex chromatic triple Borel 5 versus measurable 3 and Baire 3
decisive_failure: No complete or publishable partial result was obtained: the Borel-5 half alone replays prior art (Brandt Corollary 5.4) while the relaxed 3-colorings below Brooks bound 4 remain unconstructed, with off-the-shelf probabilistic routes quantitatively excluded (LLL 6.3427 above 1, cluster expansion 5.88x short). Work was bounded to source extraction plus logged LLL, cluster-expansion, spectral, and finite-ball screens; ergodic toast and factor constructions were not achievable in-session, and no independently valuable emergent finding was produced.

Determine its exact definable chromatic triple: is the Borel chromatic number 5 while both the measure-measurable and Baire-measurable chromatic numbers equal 3?
